findings.title: No NetworkPolicy in namespace shop
findings.evidence: C-0030 fails for 3 workloads in shop
findings.verification_evidence: Namespace shop has 2 NetworkPolicies: "default-deny-ingress" (podSelector {}, default_deny_ingress true) and "allow-web", so the "no NetworkPolicy" claim is wrong. Egress is not restricted, but that isn't what the finding says.

findings.title: No NetworkPolicy in namespace dev
findings.evidence: C-0030 fails for 2 workloads in dev
findings.verification_evidence: list_network_policies for namespace dev returned count 0 and policies [], so no NetworkPolicy exists there.

findings.title: qa has no default-deny ingress policy
findings.verification_evidence: Namespace qa has only one NetworkPolicy, "allow-api". It selects app=api only and has default_deny_ingress:false, so there is no default-deny ingress policy.

findings.title: shop workloads can make any outbound connection
findings.evidence: C-0030 egress not blocked in shop
findings.verification_evidence: The shop namespace has only two NetworkPolicies, "default-deny-ingress" and "allow-web". Both have policyTypes ["Ingress"] only, so default_deny_egress is false and egress is unrestricted.
